ownedNewFiles.proposedContribution: Define versioned request/result/error schemas and node descriptors for automation.previewDocumentArtifact, automation.applyDigestDecision and automation.reconcileDocumentStep. Define ArtifactManifest/ApprovalCheckpoint/StepReceipt projections referencing canonical owners, not new stores. Require document revision, workflow/schema version, logical step ref/key, operationId, expectedRevision, namespace and applicable authorityEpoch; bind digest to exact command payload, revision, format/theme and declared effects/recipients. Model waiting/approved/rejected/expired, invalidated digest, queuedProvider and unknownExternalResult distinctly. Accept authenticated principal only as trusted server execution context. Reuse the accepted registry/compiler interface from LSX-WP-041; fail closed missingDependency when owners are unavailable. Names/interfaces here are proposals, not existing implementations.

Implement adapter methods for the three operations against accepted Docs/export, immutable run/step, approval and common policy owners. Preview is read/validation-only and never creates an effect/grant/signature. Render/apply as authorized runtime actions under frozen version and one logical key; reread current Doc and ACL/asset/export/approver policy before committing decisions/effects. Reject changed revision/digest, expired and revoked decisions. Persist native receipt references through existing runtime, reconcile by the original key, preserve queued/unknown and committed partial effects on cancel. Use registered authorized compensation only; no ad hoc rollback or duplicated owner database.

Deterministic semantic tests: immutable artifact hash/ref/revision, changed Doc while awaiting approval, wrong exact digest, revoked/expired approver, payload actor spoof, same-key duplicate and after-effect crash/restart, queued/unknown reconciliation, cancellation retaining committed receipts and blocking unstarted steps, stopOnError and authorized registered compensation. Persist seed/input/version receipts for baseline and separately seeded digest/key mutants. Unit fixtures do not replace native owner/restart proof.

Use the discovered supported actual Electron runner to exercise existing RA-05/06/07/08 against authoritative owners. Verify immutable revision/effects/recipient preview, approved/rejected/expired/conflict/denied/queued/unknown/partial-cancel text, keyboard review/decision/cancel, pointer/IME/focus/Escape, help, reduced motion, zoom200%, light/dark, Russian and locale parity, actual loaded Rox Mono; capture synthetic/redacted screenshots/ARIA and reload/readback. No invented passing runner or fixture replacement.

risks: Four explicit LSX dependencies do not supply proof of generic workflow durability or approval/signature readiness; adapter implementation must not silently recreate broad RS products.

RS-APR-01 and RS-SIG-01 are definition/viewer specifications, not evidence of an executable native decision or signature owner. Their related RS-APR-02/RS-SIG-02 owner interfaces must be resolved by lead, not inferred from issue names.

Current allowed paths cannot alone bind executable graph kinds, new protocol/client methods, authenticated principal/host composition or UI/i18n. Missing binding is a reviewed scope/interface prerequisite, not permission to edit read-only evidence paths.
Retry scheduler has an after-effect process-loss window; timestamp/random queue identity cannot stand in for stable logical side-effect idempotency. Wrapping it would preserve duplicate-effect risk.
History compaction can remove records, and append history does not prove a durable native commit. Treating it as recovery state would either lose checkpoints or create a second store.
Config revision FNV is optimistic concurrency only; it must not be reused as cryptographic Doc/artifact/payload approval digest.
Replaying current editable matchers or using old grants can execute different effects under stale approval. Use frozen workflow/schema/Doc refs with current authorization.
Cancel cannot reverse already committed external effects; timeout/queued/unknown must not become autoapproved or successful by UI shorthand.
Mutexes and single-process queue locks are not cross-owner transactions or distributed leases. Durable owner handoff/reconciliation must be proven.
Inspected tree may change during root wave0/dependency integration. Whole-file hashes bind this evidence only; stale anchors must be re-read, not blindly patched.
No product runtime/UI/negative-control proof is claimed. Report/schema validation cannot close any feature DoD lane.
